SELECT gsc.ct_id, gsc.it_id, gsc.it_name, gsc.ct_price, gsc.ct_point, gsc.ct_qty, gsc.ct_status, gsc.ct_send_cost, gsc.it_sc_type, gsi.it_cust_price, gsc.ct_option, gsi.it_2, gsi.it_price, gsi.ca_id, gsi.ca_id2, gsi.ca_id3, CASE WHEN gsi.it_img1 != '' THEN CONCAT(#{imageServerUri}, gsi.it_img1) ELSE NULL END AS it_img1, gsi.it_sc_price , gsi.it_point, CASE WHEN gsi.it_sc_type = 0 OR gsi.it_10 = 'use' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN gsc.ct_price < de_send_cost_limit THEN de_send_cost_list ELSE 0 END FROM g5_shop_default LIMIT 1) WHEN gsi.it_sc_type = 2 AND gsc.ct_price < gsc.it_sc_minimum THEN gsc.it_sc_price WHEN gsi.it_sc_type = 3 THEN gsc.it_sc_price WHEN gsi.it_sc_type = 4 THEN gsc.it_sc_price * gsc.it_sc_qty ELSE 0 END AS real_ship_cost, CASE WHEN gsi.it_10 = 'use' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bespoke_fl, ROUND((gsi.it_price * (it_2 / 100) / 10) * 10) AS it_review_point, gsc.pet_id, gsc.pet_history_id, gsc.urine_check_history_id, gsc.it_sc_minimum, IFNULL((SELECT urine_check_id FROM pet_urine_check_history WHERE urine_check_history_id = gsc.urine_check_history_id LIMIT 1), 0) AS urine_check_id, gsc.io_id, gsc.od_id, (SELECT de_bank_account FROM g5_shop_default LIMIT 1) AS de_bank_account, IFNULL((SELECT io_price FROM g5_shop_item_option WHERE io_id = gsc.io_id AND it_id = gsc.it_id GROUP BY io_id, it_id), 0) AS io_price, IFNULL((SELECT io_type FROM g5_shop_item_option WHERE io_id = gsc.io_id AND it_id = gsc.it_id GROUP BY io_id, it_id), 0) AS io_type FROM g5_shop_cart gsc LEFT JOIN g5_shop_item gsi ON ( gsc.it_id = gsi.it_id ) WHERE gsc.mb_id = #{mbId} AND gsc.ct_direct = 0 AND gsc.ct_status = '쇼핑' ORDER BY gsc.ct_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM g5_shop_cart WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND ct_id = #{ctId};

AND ct_id = #{ctId}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN #{ctQty} > it_stock_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS item_qty FROM g5_shop_item WHERE it_id = #{itId} LIMIT 1;
SELECT CASE WHEN #{ctQty} > io_stock_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS item_qty FROM g5_shop_item_option WHERE it_id = #{itId} AND io_id = #{ioId} LIMIT 1;
mapper.update: UPDATE g5_shop_cart SET ct_status = #{cancelStatus} WHERE od_Id = #{odId};

UPDATE g5_shop_order SET od_cancel_price = #{cancelPrice}, od_status = #{cancelStatus}, od_shop_memo = CONCAT(od_shop_memo,'주문자 본인 직접 취소 - ', NOW(), ' (취소이유 : ', #{cancelMemo}, ')') WHERE od_id = #{odId} ;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_product_back ( create_id, od_id, ct_id, price, point, product_back_name, product_back_cd, withdraw_date, withdraw_request_cd, withdraw_request_etc, tel, phone, zip1, zip2, addr1, addr2, addr3, addr_jibeon ) VALUES ( #{mbId}, #{odId}, #{ctId}, #{price}, #{point}, #{productBackName}, #{productBackCd}, #{withdrawDate}, #{withdrawRequestCd}, #{withdrawRequestEtc}, #{tel}, #{phone}, #{zip1}, #{zip2}, #{addr1}, #{addr2}, #{addr3}, #{addrJibeon} );
mapper.update: UPDATE g5_shop_cart SET ct_status = '반품' WHERE ct_Id = #{ctId};

UPDATE g5_shop_order SET od_refund_price = od_refund_price + #{price}, refund_bank = #{refundBank}, refund_deposit = #{refundDeposit}, refund_bank_account = #{refundBankAccount} WHERE od_id = #{odId};

UPDATE g5_shop_order SET od_b_name = #{adName}, od_b_tel = #{adTel}, od_b_hp = #{adHp}, od_b_zip1 = #{adZip1}, od_b_zip2 = #{adZip2}, od_b_addr1 = #{adAddr1}, od_b_addr2 = #{adAddr2}, od_b_addr3 = #{adAddr3}, od_b_addr_jibeon = #{adJibeon}, od_send_cost2 = #{odSendCost2} WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND od_id = #{odId};
UPDATE g5_shop_cart SET od_id = #{generatedOdId}, ct_status = '쇼핑', ct_select = 0 WHERE od_id = #{odId} AND ct_select = 0;
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT it_id FROM g5_shop_item WHERE it_use = 1 AND ca_id = '20' LIMIT 1) AS regular_item, (SELECT it_id FROM g5_shop_item WHERE it_use = 1 AND ca_id2 = '1050' LIMIT 1) AS adjust_item, (SELECT it_id FROM g5_shop_item WHERE it_use = 1 AND ca_id = '1070' AND ca_id2 = '10a0' LIMIT 1) AS dog_tonic_item, (SELECT it_id FROM g5_shop_item WHERE it_use = 1 AND ca_id = '1070' AND ca_id2 = '10b0' LIMIT 1) AS cat_tonic_item, (SELECT it_id FROM g5_shop_item WHERE it_use = 1 AND ca_id3 = '1040' LIMIT 1) AS kit_item
SELECT CASE WHEN gso.od_misu = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS cancel_finish_status FROM g5_shop_order gso WHERE od_id = #{odId} AND mb_id = #{mbId};
SELECT terms_of_service, privacy_policy FROM g5_shop_default LIMIT 1;
